title: Midas Touch — the Mint coin orders
shortTitle: Midas Touch — the Mint coin orders
summary: Demand for a limited coin issue exceeded the Mint’s available quantity; ordering materials and confirmation language affect the alleged agreement.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Which document was an offer and which was an invitation for orders? Did receipt or acknowledgment of payment or an order constitute acceptance? What effect should stated allocation and quantity limits have? The reference to Mesaros does not replace the requested analysis.
